reviews.title: Getting pretty fed up with this app
reviews.text:
I’ve had the service for over a decade at this point, and it looks like I’ll probably be canceling it because it’s become so shoddy. Doesn’t matter if I’m on my desktop or using my phone, it’s been a constant struggle to get connected and stay connected no matter what settings I use.

Today was the last straw. I don’t know what happened, but I lost internet access. Tried turning my phone off and on several times, didn’t work. Finally checked the app and it wouldn’t even allow me to sign off! I had to delete it off my phone completely in order to get internet access and use my phone. I’m sorry, but if your product completely cuts me off like this, I do not want it. This was the very last strike in a series of bad experiences. I’m done. Time to find a new service.

reviews.title: This app has become completely unusable
reviews.text: For the last week this app has become complete unusable on my iPad. It shows I’m connected but apps that need me connected to the US won’t work. When I open the app every time all I see is the screen that shows sign up/login and a spinning wheel which won’t let me access any buttons. When I hard press the app to disconnect and reconnect it always reconnects me to Adelaide AU and nothing will work when I press anything to try to change the connection. I’ve tried deleting the app and reloading and nothing changes. Now this last time when I tried to log back in again, I’m getting No Internet Connection when I absolutely have an internet connection. Ready to cancel my subscription because if I can’t use this on my iPad there is no point in having it.

reviews.title: Often blocks communication without notice
reviews.text:
What I found about this app after struggling with it (love/hate) is that it will often and without explanation or notice block all network communication (in iOS settings this condition shows as "VPN connecting").  When this happens, no action within the PIA app will help.  Switch it off, it will immediately switch itself back on.

If the VPN is disabled in iOS settings (bnot possible in the app), communication immediately resumes (without protection, of course).  So I stopped using the app.  Two years later, I decided to try it again.  On day 1, the problem reappeared.

I would rather run unprotected than unreliable software.  A shame!  It is so good when it's good!

reviews.title: Fails to connect every time, second try works
reviews.text: The service is OK, but the apps on iOS and macOS are pretty bad. As well as failing to connect first time, you can't search or filter the country list by typing, and your favourites don't appear at the top or on their own list so that feature is essentially useless. It's such a bad user experience on many levels. Definitely not fully native app, nowhere near the quality Apple users expect, should be much better.

reviews.title: Unbelievably Bad
reviews.text:
Contacted support on 26th October, got an auto response asking what I’ve tried and what my setup is. Haven’t heard anything since. 

Issue is constant freezing on streamed content. Constant. No matter what location I try. I use this everyday, so this delay is really frustrating, and just after I’ve renewed for 3 years. 

I’ve been all over AI for advice on settings, and nothing works - just like PIA’s support team. 

In frustration, I set up a FREE Proton VPN account, and it works flawlessly. No issues. 

PIA I want my subscription back due to you not providing the service I’ve paid for. 

Bad customer support / service and a bad product. Don’t know what’s happened as I’ve been using this for a few years. 

AVOID.
